verdict.rationale: Sill streams either a single Mac window or the whole desktop. Its bar puts every window one tap away as thumbnails, and an Apps list shows open and installed apps, so switching windows and apps mid-session is documented. Nothing shows choosing among multiple physical monitors on a multi-display host; the virtual display only isolates a streamed window. missing for 10: explicit selection of a specific monitor on a multi-display Mac, switching between monitors mid-session, independent or hands-on corroboration.
